channel.access: Authenticated repository users with sufficient write access; not anonymous/public delivery. Find the named draft in Releases or use gh release download with draftTagName. GitHub changes temporary untagged URLs when a draft is edited.
channel.verified: Saved as draft, uploaded state and GitHub digest checked; authenticated download and local SHA-256 verified. No public Git tag was created.
channel.cloudSessionAccess: Not tested; the owner may instead attach the identical ZIP directly to Claude Cloud.

runtime.note: Download/attachment transport only. Configure verified files on the actual preview or separately approved production media origin.
